subject.title: [Feature]: Reopen session history around a sessions_search hit

question: Should sessions_history and chat.history adopt sessionId plus messageId as a supported anchor-centered core contract, and should that work be split from the interrupted-turn changes in the linked PR?
rationale: This adds a durable public tool and Gateway protocol capability with archive-selection and pagination semantics; code inspection can validate feasibility, but maintainers must confirm the permanent API boundary and review shape.

options.title: Sponsor focused anchored recall
options.body: Approve the contract and ask for the anchored-history portion to land as a focused change with protocol, authorization, archive, and snapshot tests.

options.title: Keep the combined PR
options.body: Approve reviewing both long-session changes together despite the broader ownership and validation surface.

options.title: Decline the core API
options.body: Keep search snippets and offset paging as the supported contract and close both this issue and the anchored-history portion of the linked PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused anchored recall
recommendation.body: Approve the contract and ask for the anchored-history portion to land as a focused change with protocol, authorization, archive, and snapshot tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent transcript/core architecture work makes steipete the best available owner for the permanent history API boundary.
